Mandatory documents to be attached in support of a bove past performance are Purchase Order/Work Order copies along with CRAC or completion ce rtificate by Gazetted Office. 7.Warranty:1.Three years of Comprehensive support. 2.The Vendor/contractor has to provide full support during the warranty period.
